source.rowNumberDefinition: One-based position in the historical missionsData array, not the HTML line number.

caveats: This is a bounded review, not a complete current diplomatic directory. Unreviewed historical rows are not validated by this file.

Address verification does not establish coordinates, visitor access, opening status or available services. All coordinates remain null because no official numeric map marker was retrieved during this review.
Only published institutional office addresses are included. Personal names, residences, private telephone numbers and postal boxes are excluded.
A DFAT Australian Capital Territory section heading is not proof of an Australian physical location. Non-resident accreditation must follow the actual chancery address.
Consulate headquarters and visa application service centres are different offices and must not be silently substituted.

reviews.officialName: Embassy of the Republic of Albania

sources.supports: DFAT identifies the Albanian embassy's chancery at 13 Culgoa Circuit.

reviews.reason: The historical address agrees with current DFAT. The historical Libya row repeats this address, but current DFAT places Libya at a different street number.
reviews.nextAction: Obtain an official map marker or separately reviewed address-geocoding evidence before adding a point.

reviews.officialName: Consulate-General of the People's Republic of China in Sydney

sources.supports: The current consulate homepage publishes the head office address at 39 Dunblane Street.
The official notice distinguishes consulates from the separately addressed Sydney and Melbourne visa application service centres.

reviews.reason: The historical headquarters address agrees with the current official website. A visa service centre is not the consulate headquarters.
reviews.nextAction: Obtain a map marker for the head office, not a visa service centre, before adding a point.

reviews.officialName: Consulate-General of the People's Republic of China in Brisbane

reviews.reason: The historical consulate office address agrees with the official guide. Separate visa centre changes do not justify deleting or relocating this consulate.
reviews.nextAction: Obtain an official map marker or separately reviewed address-geocoding evidence for the consulate office.

reviews.officialName: Embassy of the Republic of Ecuador

sources.supports: DFAT identifies the Ecuadorian embassy chancery at 59 Hopetoun Circuit in Yarralumla.
Ecuador's foreign ministry mission page gives the same Yarralumla address and Canberra city.

reviews.reason: The historical row labels Canberra but supplies a Collins Street, Melbourne address. Two official sources identify the embassy's Canberra chancery; the Melbourne address must not be geocoded as this embassy.
reviews.nextAction: Use the reviewed chancery address for separate coordinate verification, retaining the historical conflict in the audit.

reviews.officialName: Embassy of the Republic of Kazakhstan
reviews.officialAddress: 1 Kim Seng Promenade, #09-04/05 Great World City, East Office Tower, Singapore 237994

sources.supports: DFAT gives the accredited embassy's chancery address in Singapore, despite an Australian Capital Territory section heading.
DFAT marks Kazakhstan's ambassador with its non-resident indicator. No personal details are reproduced in this review.

reviews.reason: The current accredited embassy is non-resident in Singapore. The historical Canberra embassy address cannot be promoted as a current Australia-based office merely from the DFAT ACT section heading.
reviews.nextAction: Exclude this historical row from an Australia-located point layer. Review any separate Australian consulate as its own institution, not as a replacement Canberra embassy.

reviews.officialName: Embassy of the Kingdom of Lesotho
reviews.officialAddress: 7 Chome-5-47, Akasaka, Minato City, Tokyo 107-0052, Japan

sources.supports: DFAT labels the mission Embassy of the Kingdom of Lesotho and gives its chancery address in Tokyo, Japan, despite placing it under an Australian Capital Territory section heading.

reviews.reason: The historical Canberra High Commission cannot be treated as a current Australia-based office. The current DFAT record points to a non-resident embassy in Japan and a different mission type. An ACT page heading is not physical-location evidence.
reviews.nextAction: Exclude from an Australia-located point layer. Retain the historical row as a non-resident/reclassified hold; represent the Tokyo accreditation only in a separately labelled scope after further review.

sources.supports: DFAT gives the Libyan embassy's physical chancery at 50 Culgoa Circuit. The first listed address is a postal box and is not the physical office.

reviews.reason: The historical Libya address duplicates the historical Albania address. Current DFAT distinguishes Libya at number 50 from Albania at number 13.

reviews.officialName: General Delegation of Palestine to Australia, New Zealand and the Pacific

sources.supports: The mission's own About the Embassy page describes the General Delegation and explicitly gives 2/44 Dalman Crescent as its street address, separately from a postal box.
The current mission homepage carries both Embassy of the State of Palestine and General Delegation titles and repeats the Dalman Crescent street office address.

reviews.reason: The mission's published street office is not the historical 176 Mugga Way address. The public website uses both Embassy and General Delegation wording; this address review does not independently establish its Australian diplomatic classification.
reviews.nextAction: Verify an office marker at the published street address and label it General Delegation pending host-government classification review. Exclude the postal box.

reviews.officialName: Embassy of Venezuela in Australia (historical office)

sources.supports: Venezuela's foreign ministry announcement dated 13 October 2025 orders closure of the embassy in Australia and says bilateral and consular work will be handled through concurrently accredited diplomatic missions, with details to be announced.
The embassy contact page remains online with a Canberra office address, but no dated reopening confirmation. This surviving page is insufficient to override the dated ministry closure announcement.

reviews.reason: There is positive official evidence of a closure and representation restructure, not merely absence from the DFAT index. A surviving contact page does not establish that the former Canberra office still operates. No current Australian office address is accepted in this review.
reviews.nextAction: Keep this historical record unpinned. Confirm the currently accredited mission and consular arrangements from updated official sources before presenting any office as current.
